Interface TomlBinder<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the record
public interface TomlBinder<T>
Binds tables to a record, and converts the record back to a table. The annotation processor generates one for each TomlConfig record, and registers it as a service, which Toml.bind(TomlTable, Class) and Toml.toTable(Record) load with ServiceLoader.

0.1.0
